title: File:Magnetic field intensity at Earth’s surface in 2014 and 2025, as measured by ESA's SWARM satellite constellation.jpg
author: C.C. Finlay, C. Kloss, N. Gillet
description: Magnetic field intensity at Earth's surface in 2014 (top) and 2025 (bottom), as measured by ESA's SWARM spacecraft. The SAA has strengthened and expanded since 2014. Presented in Hammer projection. Units are nanoTesla (nT). From the estimated Swarm-based core field model up to spherical harmonic degree 22.
categories: Earth's magnetic field|Comparisons|2025 in science|Magnetic field maps of the world|Maps with Hammer projection|World maps showing data at subnational resolution
